source: Z-Anatomy Startup.blend, CC BY-SA 4.0, derived from BodyParts3D CC BY-SA 2.1 JP
skin: The template's Integument and External ear collections have no mesh. skull.glb and auricle.glb are the skull, mandible, cervical vertebrae, clavicles, and right auricle cartilage.
method: Axis remap from the Blender Z-up metres frame into ZETA millimetres, then translation onto the ZETA external auditory canal. Umeyama scale from canal to mastoid tip was 0.75, outside 1.0±5%, so scale stayed 1.0.
scaleWarning: Matching the estimated ZETA mastoid tip would scale the skull to 0.75. That is outside 5%, so the skull stays at 1.0 and only the canal is aligned.
pairs: mastoid tip (reported, not used for scale)
